title: Predicting The Upredictable
summary:
Predicting The Unpredictable
We are continuing our annual forecasting series and for 2025, we have another set of predictions for the market that we think are possible developments. The highly uncertain economic and (geo) political situation in the world today makes this forecast even more challenging than normal. However, we think that it is important to go through the mental exercise, organize our thoughts and anticipate alternative future developments.
